regulatory_authority: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)

standard_denial_templates.PRE_EXISTING_DISEASE: With reference to Claim ID {claim_id} submitted under Policy No {policy_no}, we regret to inform you that the claim has been repudiated under Policy Clause {clause_no} (Pre-existing Disease Waiting Period). As per clinical records, the symptoms/diagnosis of {diagnosis} originated prior to the policy inception date {inception_date}. As per policy terms, a waiting period of {waiting_period_months} months applies before expenses relating to pre-existing conditions are payable.
standard_denial_templates.MEDICAL_NECESSITY: With reference to Claim ID {claim_id} submitted under Policy No {policy_no}, the claim for {procedure} has been repudiated under Policy Clause {clause_no} (Medical Necessity). Our medical scrutiny indicates that conservative management protocol was not documented or exhausted, and active inpatient hospitalisation was not medically imperative as per standard clinical guidelines.
